name: worldbuilding-wiki
description: Hugo worldbuilding Wiki with body search, entity relations, backlinks, timeline generation, and GitHub Pages deployment.

scripts.test:maps: node --test tests/unit/map-features.test.mjs tests/unit/atlas-space.test.mjs tests/unit/atlas-blocks.test.mjs tests/unit/world-relief.test.mjs tests/unit/atlas-viewport.test.mjs tests/unit/atlas-city.test.mjs tests/unit/atlas-city-context.test.mjs tests/unit/atlas-lighting.test.mjs tests/unit/atlas-surface.test.mjs
scripts.wiki:validate: node scripts/validate-content-model.mjs && npm run map:check && node scripts/validate-maps.mjs && npm run typecheck:atlas && npm run typecheck:ui && npm run test:maps && node scripts/prepare-wiki.mjs --check
scripts.quality:all: npm run wiki:validate && npm run quality:source && npm run quality:site
scripts.wiki:preview: node scripts/prepare-wiki.mjs --check --include-drafts && node scripts/prepare-wiki.mjs --include-drafts && hugo server -D
scripts.wiki:preview-search: node scripts/prepare-wiki.mjs --check --include-drafts && node scripts/prepare-wiki.mjs --include-drafts && hugo --buildDrafts --cleanDestinationDir --gc --minify && node scripts/serve-public.mjs
scripts.wiki:build: npm run wiki:validate && npm run quality:source && npm run wiki:prepare && hugo --cleanDestinationDir --gc --minify && node scripts/verify-search-index.mjs && npm run quality:site
